title: Natural climate solutions

definition.text: Natural climate solutions are conservation, restoration and improved land-management actions that increase carbon storage or avoid greenhouse-gas emissions.

facts.text: A global evidence map found 257,266 relevant papers across 22 pathways, but fewer than 2% mentioned cost, equity or Indigenous and local communities in their abstracts.
Canada created a CAD$2B Natural Climate Solutions Fund, including CAD$885M for climate solutions in agriculture over 2021–31.

notes: Phrase concept with no page of its own; mentioned on four crawled pages.
